record.commit-date-not-a-date: --commit-date `{Text}` is not a date. Use an ISO 8601 timestamp, such as `2026-08-03T14:05:00+09:00`.
record.prune-needs-bound: --prune with neither --before nor --keep would remove every snapshot's detail. Say how far back to go.
record.before-not-a-date-or-age: `--before {Text}` is neither a date nor an age. Use an ISO 8601 date, or a number of days such as `90d`.
record.format-unknown: `--format {Format}` is not a format. Use `json`, `text` or `html`.
record.no-history-target: This recipe has no `history` target, so there is nothing to read. Add one, or point --recipe at the recipe the conversions use.
record.several-history-targets: This recipe has {Count} history targets ({Keys}). Name the one to read with --project.
record.no-target-for-project: This recipe has no history target for project `{Project}`.
record.project-unknown: The history holds no project called `{Project}`.
record.metric-unknown: `{Metric}` is not a metric. Use rows, cells, contentBytes, tables, fields, or changes.
record.metric-unknown-per-table: `{Metric}` is not a metric. Use rows, cells, contentBytes, tables, fields.
record.commit-ambiguous: `{Commit}` matches {Count} commits on branch `{Branch}`: {Matches}. Use more of the hash.
record.range-reversed: `{From}` comes after `{To}` on branch `{Branch}`, so there is no range between them. Swap them, or leave one out.
record.model-differs-for-commit: The history already holds a different model for commit {Commit} on branch `{Branch}`. That happens when a snapshot was recorded from a working copy with uncommitted changes, or when --commit named a value already used for other data. The history is not rewritten automatically: whichever of the two is wrong, overwriting hides it.
record.value-pool-id-missing: The value pool has no id for a cell holding `{Text}`, which was put there moments ago. Something removed it between the insert and the read - a prune of another branch is the only thing that does. The snapshot has not been written.
record.unreachable: The history at `{Section}` could not be reached, so nothing was recorded for this conversion: {Detail}
record.lock-held: Another process has held `{Name}` for more than {Seconds} seconds. That is another conversion of the same branch, or a prune. Wait for it and try again.
record.migration-lock-held: Another process has been migrating the history database for more than {Seconds} seconds. If nothing else is running, the lock is stale and will clear when its connection closes.
record.schema-newer-than-build: The history database is at schema version {Current}, and this build of Tabbit understands version {Understood}. Upgrade Tabbit rather than letting an older one write to it.
record.bind-not-an-address: --bind {Bind} is not an address. Use an IP, `localhost`, or `0.0.0.0` for every interface.
record.bind-public-without-token: --bind {Bind} would serve the history to anything that can reach this machine, and no token is set. Set ${Variable} to a secret and send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, or leave --bind at 127.0.0.1.
record.snapshot-not-found: The history has no snapshot for `{Commit}` on branch `{Branch}` of `{Project}`, and no working copy here could resolve it as a tag or a revision. Either nothing converted that commit, or it is on another branch, or there is no checkout to look the name up in.
